entries.title: Genesis 23:1
segments: ¶Sarah lived one hundred and twenty-seven years; [these were] the years of the life of Sarah.

entries.title: Genesis 23:2
segments: So Sarah died in Kirjath Arba (that [is], Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah and to weep for her.

entries.title: Genesis 23:3
segments: ¶Then Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spoke to the sons of Heth, saying,

entries.title: Genesis 23:4
segments: "I [am] a foreigner and a visitor among you. Give me property for a burial place among you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight."

entries.title: Genesis 23:5
segments: And the sons of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,

entries.title: Genesis 23:6
segments: "Hear us, my lord: You [are] a mighty prince among us; bury your dead in the choicest of our burial places. None of us will withhold from you his burial place, that you may bury your dead."

entries.title: Genesis 23:7
segments: Then Abraham stood up and bowed himself to the people of the land, the sons of Heth.

entries.title: Genesis 23:8
segments: And he spoke with them, saying, "If it is your wish that I bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and meet with Ephron the son of Zohar for me,

entries.title: Genesis 23:9
segments: "that he may give me the cave of Machpelah which he has, which [is] at the end of his field. Let him give it to me at the full price, as property for a burial place among you."

entries.title: Genesis 23:10
segments: Now Ephron dwelt among the sons of Heth; and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the presence of the sons of Heth, all who entered at the gate of his city, saying,

entries.title: Genesis 23:11
segments: "No, my lord, hear me: I give you the field and the cave that [is] in it; I give it to you in the presence of the sons of my people. I give it to you. Bury your dead!"

entries.title: Genesis 23:12
segments: Then Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land;

entries.title: Genesis 23:13
segments: and he spoke to Ephron in the hearing of the people of the land, saying, "If you [will give it], please hear me. I will give you money for the field; take [it] from me and I will bury my dead there."

entries.title: Genesis 23:14
segments: And Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

entries.title: Genesis 23:15
segments: "My lord, listen to me; the land [is worth] four hundred shekels of silver. What [is] that between you and me? So bury your dead."

entries.title: Genesis 23:16
segments: ¶And Abraham listened to Ephron; and Abraham weighed out the silver for Ephron which he had named in the hearing of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, currency of the merchants.

entries.title: Genesis 23:17
segments: So the field of Ephron which [was] in Machpelah, which [was] before Mamre, the field and the cave which [was] in it, and all the trees that [were] in the field, which [were] within all the surrounding borders, were deeded

entries.title: Genesis 23:18
segments: to Abraham as a possession in the presence of the sons of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.

entries.title: Genesis 23:19
segments: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah, before Mamre (that [is], Hebron) in the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 23:20
segments: So the field and the cave that [is] in it were deeded to Abraham by the sons of Heth as property for a burial place.
